description.value: Bridge Brewing Company is a North Vancouver craft brewery operating a taproom and tasting room at its original Charlotte Road location, one of three Bridge Brewing venues across the North Shore. The taproom pours a rotating lineup of core and seasonal house beers, and the site also hosts a playful 'Bridge Arcade' experience. A keg rental program and private event space at a sister location round out the brewery's community presence.
